findings.source_quote: “as old as your cynicism”; “pessimistic, cynical people”; “growing pessimistic and cynical”; “pessimism, cynicism, and doubt”
findings.suggested_fix: Use Kiswahili expressions conveying cynicism or habitual skepticism, such as “kubeza” or “kutilia shaka,” rather than “mashaka ya kijinga,” which means foolish doubts. For example: “Una umri mkubwa kadiri ulivyo na tabia ya kubeza,” and “watu wenye mtazamo wa kukata tamaa na wa kubeza.”
findings.translation_quote: “umri mkubwa kadiri ya mashaka yako ya kijinga”; “watu wenye mtazamo wa kukata tamaa na mashaka ya kijinga”; “wenye mtazamo wa kukata tamaa na mashaka ya kijinga”; “mtazamo wa kukata tamaa, mashaka ya kijinga na shaka”
